name: Urban Cadastral AI - Land Boundary & VLM Mapping System
description: AI-powered urban cadastral mapping and land management system featuring Google Maps satellite house detection, Tamil Nadu official land & layout map repositories (FMB/TSLR, CMDA, DTCP 1974-2026), affine GCP georeferencing, comparative encroachment analysis (E = B_detected \ L_legal), and Gemini VLM statutory municipal notice generation.
